description: This file defines classes and structures related to source code range handling in the Torch JIT compiler, including StringCordView, Source, SourceRange, and related utilities.

classes.name: StringCordView
classes.description: A string-like class backed by a vector of string_view, representing concatenated string segments without requiring continuous memory.

classes.name: Source
classes.description: Represents a segment of source code, with optional filename and line number info.

classes.name: SourceRange
classes.description: A reference to a subset of a Source, specified by start and end byte offsets.

classes.name: OwnedSourceRange
classes.description: A SourceRange that owns its underlying Source object.

classes.name: StackEntry
classes.description: Represents a stack trace entry with filename and source range.

classes.name: TaggedRange
classes.description: Associates a byte count with a SourceRange, describing a segment of output.

methods.name: operator++
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next character position.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between iterators or SourceRanges.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality between iterators or SourceRanges.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Dereferences the iterator to get the current character.

methods.name: rest_line
methods.description: Returns the remaining part of the current line from the iterator position.

methods.name: pos
methods.description: Returns the current position of the iterator within the source.

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Highlights the source range, used for error reporting.

methods.name: print_with_context
methods.description: Prints the source range with context, optionally highlighting.

methods.name: findSourceRangeThatGenerated
methods.description: Finds the source range that generated the current range.
